Geometry_and_Silhouette: Single-wheeled vehicle with pedals directly attached to the wheel hub.
Frame consists of a seat post rising from the wheel fork, terminating in a saddle seat.
Overall height 60-120 cm depending on wheel size.
Functional_Components: Crank arms extend from the hub with flat pedals.
No handlebars or steering mechanism - balance is controlled by body position.
Wheel diameter ranges from 12 inches to 36 inches.
Material_and_Context: Frame is steel or aluminum in various colors.
Tire is narrow with a smooth or lightly treaded surface.
Single-wheeled human-powered vehicle.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Vertical piano with a tall rectangular cabinet approximately 110-140 cm high.
Front panel opens to reveal 88 keys arranged in the standard chromatic pattern.
Overall silhouette is tall and narrow compared to grand pianos.
Functional_Components: Music stand extends from the top front.
Three pedals protrude from the base.
Interior strings run vertically behind the keys.
Material_and_Context: Cabinet is finished in polished ebony, mahogany, or walnut.
Soundboard is visible through the open front.
Legs are short and blocky.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Electric cleaning appliance with a body housing a motor and dust collection system.
Upright models have a tall handle extending from a rectangular cleaning head.
Canister models have a compact body on wheels with a flexible hose and wand.
Functional_Components: Cleaning head has bristles and a suction opening.
Dust bag or bagless cyclone container is visible.
Controls on the handle include power switch and brush roll on/off.
Material_and_Context: Color is typically white, gray, red, or blue.
Power cord extends from the rear, 6-10 meters.
Weight 3-8 kg.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Open decorative container with a narrow neck and wider body.
Height ranges from 15-50 cm.
Shape varies: cylindrical, bulbous, tapered, or fluted.
Functional_Components: Opening at the top is circular or oval, 3-10 cm in diameter.
Base is flat and stable.
Glass vases show water level when filled.
Material_and_Context: Material is glass, ceramic, porcelain, or metal.
Surface may feature painted patterns, etched designs, or a smooth monochrome finish.
Ceramic vases have an unglazed foot ring on the bottom.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Arched architectural ceiling or roof constructed from brick, stone, or concrete blocks.
Arch forms a continuous curved surface spanning between walls or piers.
Types include barrel vault, groin vault, and ribbed vault.
Functional_Components: Surface shows individual masonry units with mortar joints.
The arch creates a sense of height and grandeur.
Interior surface may be decorated with frescoes or coffered patterns.
Material_and_Context: Color reflects the material: warm terracotta for brick, gray for stone, white for plaster.
Architectural ceiling structure.
Stone ribs support ribbed vault types.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Luxurious fabric with a dense pile of evenly cut short fibers creating a smooth soft surface.
Pile height is 1-3 mm, giving a plush tactile quality.
Fabric drapes heavily and folds in soft rounded creases.
Functional_Components: Surface has a characteristic sheen that changes appearance depending on the viewing angle.
Back side is a plain weave without pile.
Crushed velvet shows an irregular pattern where the pile has been pressed in different directions.
Material_and_Context: Color is rich and saturated: deep red, royal blue, emerald green, black, or gold.
Light reflects differently from the nap direction.
Luxurious textile fabric.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Tall rectangular dispensing machine with a glass front displaying rows of products.
Overall dimensions approximately 180 cm tall, 90 cm wide, 80 cm deep.
Body is metal painted in brand colors.
Functional_Components: Glass panel reveals product coils or shelves behind it.
Payment interface includes a bill acceptor, coin slot, and/or card reader.
Product selection keypad has numbered buttons with a dispensing tray at the bottom.
Material_and_Context: Interior lighting illuminates the products.
LED display shows price and selection information.
Automated retail dispensing machine.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Ceremonial religious garment worn by clergy during worship services.
Shape is wide and open, draping over the shoulders and extending to the ankles.
Long flowing robe or chasuble form.
Functional_Components: Surface features embroidered crosses, symbols, or decorative borders.
Some versions have an orphrey running down the front and back.
Worn over an alb with a stole draped around the neck.
Material_and_Context: Made from rich fabric such as silk, brocade, or damask in liturgical colors.
Fabric has a lustrous sheen.
Liturgical colors include white, red, green, purple, and gold.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Long bridge-like structure consisting of a series of arches or spans supported by tall piers.
Individual arches are semicircular or segmental.
Overall length can exceed 500 meters.
Functional_Components: Piers are massive rectangular or cylindrical columns spaced at regular intervals.
Deck runs continuously across the top of the arches.
Extends across a valley, road, or railway.
Material_and_Context: Constructed from stone, brick, or concrete.
Color reflects construction material: gray concrete, red brick, or natural stone.
Height varies with the terrain being crossed.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long.
Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts on each side.
Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top.
Functional_Components: Four strings run from a tailpiece over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll.
Top plate has two f-shaped sound holes.
Fingerboard is ebony black with a chin rest attached at the lower left.
Material_and_Context: Top plate is spruce; back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern.
Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden.
Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.
